text_block_list.text:
One day in the main courtyard, Seiun Sky and
Matikanefukukitaru were debating different points of view.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Strategy really is the most important thing when it comes to winning races, huh~

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
No, it's luck. But they say luck is part of
one's skill too, don't they?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ehh, luck is just hindsight for when things happen to go well, you know~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hoh. In that case, prove it by catching me within the next 20 minutes.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Although, my fortune today is
super duper happy, so that won't happen.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
—Ah!
Look, Lady Shiraoki is over there!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Huh? Where is it?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Gotcha!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Wait, waah!
Why is there a banana peel here of all placesーー!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"I was almost done in by their cowardly plan!
Lady Luck was on my side after all, hahahaha!!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah... She got away.
Well, winning on pure luck was never gonna happen anyway.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, to get back to the classroom, she'll definitely have to pass through the hallway.
This time I'm sure to catch Fukukitaru-san.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: This is truly a victory of intellect and strategy—

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Seiun Sky, good timing.
Could you give me a hand carrying these documents?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: (Wait, another accident...?!)

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, while Sky-san is keeping them busy,
I'll slip behind the teacher...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Um, carrying this all by yourself looks pretty tough,
so would it be okay if I asked someone to help?

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: Well, I don't mind either way, but...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Looks like it, Fukukitaru-san!
We're counting on you!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Eep, you noticed!?
And here I thought I could sneak on by!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Fufufu... And so, I've caught you, Fukukitaru-san.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hauu...
That quick thinking at the very end was magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Not at all~. If anything, I should be
the one thanking you.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Thanks to that, I gained some wonderful insights~.

Through this incident, Seiun Sky managed to
acquire an even more flexible adaptability.
